I’m using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

All commands below are synthetic. The process cwd remains `/work/widget`; `git -C` explicitly selects another checkout.

### 1. Resolve the PR-head workspace

Resolved from the supplied context:

- `GIT_DIR = GIT_COMMON = /work/widget/.git`; not a submodule; HEAD attached.
- `ROOT=/work/widget`
- Home: `acme/widget#12`, branch `fix/retry`
- `NAME=fix-retry`
- `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
- Members, in order: #13 at `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`; #14 at `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`
- All PRs target `main` and are in-repository.
- No local overrides, native tool, or wrapper applies; use the built-in existing-branch checkout.

Setting up an isolated worktree at `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` on branch `fix/retry` for this work.

### 2. Fetch and validate before writes

Every command in this section has cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git -C /work/widget fetch origin
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/cap
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry-docs
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main
```

Fetch succeeds; every object exists and every remote head equals its supplied original SHA.

Resolved:

```text
BASE_SHA=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
```

Ordered stops: no fork-hosted PRs; then inspect branch occupancy:

```sh
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
```

No admitted branch is checked out elsewhere. Reachability and remote-equality checks passed.

```sh
git -C /work/widget for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads/fix/retry
```

Empty: no local home branch, hence no recovery history to validate.

### 3. Check source hygiene and provision

Commands, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git -C /work/widget status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees
```

Status succeeds with empty output. Ignore check succeeds: `.worktrees` is already ignored; no ignore-file write or commit.

```sh
git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry fix/retry
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
```

Unique-remote DWIM creates/checks out `fix/retry` tracking `origin/fix/retry`. Listing confirms the selected home. HEAD equals `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.

### 4. Merge members in order

Commands, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m 'merge PR #13 head bbbbbbb into PR #12' bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
```

Saved last-good head: original #12 head. Clean merge: `eeeeeee`.

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m 'merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12' cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
```

Saved last-good head: `eeeeeee`. Conflict and snapshot: `UU src/retry.ts`; exact conflict list: `src/retry.ts`.

Read the first-found overrides from the fetched base, not the conflicted tree:

```sh
for p in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md gauntlet-overrides.md doc/gauntlet-overrides.md; do
  if git -C /work/widget cat-file -e "dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd:$p"; then
    git -C /work/widget show "dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd:$p"
    break
  fi
done
```

Resolved runner: documented under `## PR gate`, `node --test <files>`, `requires credentials: false`.

Fresh foreground helper payload:

```text
role: implementer
cwd: /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
async: false
conflicted_paths: [src/retry.ts]
fetched_base: dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [node --test test/retry.test.mjs]
Resolve every listed conflict preserving both sides' intent.
Edit only src/retry.ts. Run exactly the supplied scoped command.
Stage the resolved file using git -C.
Do not commit or abort.
Return done, or done - contract exception: <why>.
```

Helper commands, cwd `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`, after resolving the file:

```sh
node --test test/retry.test.mjs
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry add src/retry.ts
```

Tests pass; helper returns `done`.

Orchestrator commands, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --cached --name-only
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry commit --no-edit
```

Checks: empty unmerged index; staged `src/retry.ts`; status delta contained in that file. **The orchestrator owns the commit**, yielding `fffffff` with canonical subject `merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12`.

### 5. Merge base and prove provenance

Commands, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc HEAD
```

Base merge: `1111111`. All ancestry checks succeed.
